channel.title: Ganza Consulting — Blog
channel.description: Long-form, no-fluff articles on business consulting, process automation and AI, project management and web development — written from delivered engagements, not from a content calendar.

item.title: The Consulting Retainer Trap: Why Monthly Retainers Rarely Solve Real Problems
item.description: Why most consulting retainers become a subscription to activity, the three cases where a retainer is genuinely the right structure, four signs yours has drifted, and the renewal conversation that fixes it.

item.title: Small Business Automation: What to Automate First (and What to Leave Alone)
item.description: How to rank automation candidates by payback rather than by annoyance, the five that work for small teams, build-vs-buy-vs-no-code trade-offs, a 90-day sequence, and where AI actually helps in 2026.

item.title: Why Your Multilingual Website Isn't Converting (It's Not About Translation)
item.description: Layout that breaks on longer strings, trust signals that don't transfer, payment expectations, hreflang mistakes that hide half your site from search — the technical and cultural reasons a translated site still doesn't sell.

item.title: When Not to Automate: The Hidden Risk of Automating Broken Processes
item.description: Six categories of process that should not be automated, the hidden costs missing from every business case, and a scorecard for deciding whether a process deserves to survive in its current form at all.

item.title: Why ERP Implementations Fail: 7 Failure Modes and the Early Signal for Each
item.description: Seven recurring ERP failure modes drawn from publicly documented cases, the early warning signal each produces, cheap countermeasures, and a pre-go-live checklist that catches most of them.

item.title: The One-Person Consulting Studio: When Small Beats Big (and When It Doesn't)
item.description: How agency economics create the gap between who sells the work and who does it, where a one-person studio is genuinely better, where it is genuinely worse, and what continuity guarantees to demand from either.

item.title: The Audit Nobody Reads: Why Most Business Audits Fail to Drive Change
item.description: Why a correct 60-slide audit changes nothing, the structural reasons consultants write them that way, and how to specify a business audit that produces a decision instead of a PDF.

item.title: How to Choose a Business Consultant: 9 Questions That Separate Expertise From a Good Deck
item.description: Nine questions to ask a consultant before signing, what a good and a bad answer sound like for each, the proposal red flags worth walking away from, and how to structure a low-risk first engagement.

item.title: Why Startups Need Consulting (Even the Ones That Think They Can't Afford It)
item.description: The runway maths behind hiring outside expertise at seed stage, the four moments when it pays for itself, how to scope an engagement so it can't drift into a retainer, and when a founder genuinely shouldn't hire anyone.

item.title: How Lidl Lost €500 Million: A Case Study in Digital Transformation Failure
item.description: A breakdown of Lidl's abandoned SAP rollout: how customising software instead of changing one process, plus a widening gap between reports and reality, burned roughly €500 million — and the five checks that catch the same drift early.

item.title: How Much Does Business Consulting Cost in 2026? Rates, Models and What Drives the Number
item.description: Real 2026 benchmarks for consulting rates by supplier type, the four pricing models and what each one optimises, the seven factors that move a quote, and how to read a proposal for padding.

item.title: Infrastructure Inbreeding: Why Promoting Only From Within Puts Your Company at Risk
item.description: Why a closed leadership pipeline quietly erodes a company's ability to adapt, the five symptoms that show up before the numbers move, and a diagnostic you can run on your own org chart in 20 minutes.
